_comment: Second Railway service: the Bull queue worker. Railway only auto-reads
railway.json (or railway.toml) from the repo root, so this file is a checked-in
template rather than something the CLI picks up: create a second service in the
project from this same repository and paste these two values into its settings
(Build: Nixpacks, Start Command: npm run start:worker). See
docs/DEPLOYMENT.md 'Two-service topology' for why this process has to exist at
all: it owns the mail, notification, export and maintenance queues, and the
hourly cleanup-expired job is the only thing that prunes the Change collection,
whose payload column holds plaintext user content.
